modelingNotes: Terminals 1 and 2 are manufacturer diagram markings. One protected interruptible pole; no permanent fixed link. Drawn open reference state does not simulate trip dynamics or prescribe operating state.
4 A at 30 degrees C; curve C magnetic operation 5-10 times In. Ratings page: https://img.yumpu.com/16219073/16/1200x1600/multi-9-sistema-apparecchiature-modulari.jpg.

CEI EN 60898: 1P Icn 6000 A at 230/400 V AC. CEI EN 60947-2: 1P Icu 10 kA at 230-240 V AC; 3 kA at 400-415 V only for one pole in an isolated-neutral system under double-fault conditions. No scalar nominal voltage or unconditional breaking capacity assigned; DC capability not established.

Cage terminals: up to 16 mm2 flexible or 25 mm2 rigid conductors for ratings up to 25 A. Connection requirements depend on application. Separate auxiliary devices are not part of this bare breaker model.

connectionCoverage.notes: Bare 24238: terminals 1 and 2 across its single protected pole, verified in exact catalog selection table and E45092 diagram. No neutral, PE, signal or communication connections in this 1P circuit; separate accessories excluded.
